text: If I had to start buying China hauls from zero, this is exactly what I'd do. Number one: grab your coupons first. Never pay full price for shipping when a coupon can cut it. Number two: start with clothes. No liquids, no batteries, no headaches. Number three: always check your QC photos. Seller pictures can look perfect, but the real item can look totally different. Number four: drop the shoeboxes. Unless you really need the box, you're paying to ship air. Number five: vacuum-pack your jackets. Puffers eat space, and space costs money. Do these five things from day one, and you'll save a lot. And if you need an agent, I use PikoBuy for all my hauls.
